title: unitUid
responsibility: Reads and writes the stable uid a unit's source files announce in their first lines.

inputs.name: readUid.code
inputs.description: The text of a source file.

inputs.name: uidComment.path
inputs.description: The repository path, whose extension decides the comment style.

inputs.name: withUid.path
inputs.description: The repository path of the file.

inputs.name: withUid.code
inputs.description: The current text of the file.

outputs.name: readUid
outputs.description: The uid announced in the first 1000 characters, or undefined when there is none or it is malformed.

outputs.name: uidComment
outputs.description: The one comment line in the file kind's own syntax, or undefined for a kind that takes no comment.

outputs.name: withUid
outputs.description: The text with the line added after a shebang or leading harness comments; unchanged when it already announces a uid or takes no comment.
